ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg. · also ἄλλον … ἄλλον, correlative: ’one … another’
ἄλλοτε: ἄλλοτε — at another time, at one time … at another; adv.
ἄλφιτα: ἄλφιτον — barley-groats, barley-meal (usu. pl.); neut. acc. pl.
ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual adj./pron., of two persons: ’both (of them)’ · also dual, of two things: ’both (hands)’
ἄνδιχα: ἄνδιχα — in two, apart; adv. (= ἀνὰ δίχα, Attic δίχα)
ἄντυγα: ἄντυξ — rim (of a shield), rail (of a chariot); fem. acc. sg.
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, accented ἄρά before an enclitic
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄρης: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. nom. sg.
ἄρουραν: ἄρουρα — tilled land, ploughland, earth; fem. acc. sg.
ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time, along; adv./prep. + dat.
ἆλτο: ἅλλομαι — leap, spring; aor. 3 sg. mid., athematic, epic (= Attic ἥλατο): ’sprang’
ἐγγὺς: ἐγγύς — near, close by; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’near’
ἐγχείῃσιν: ἐγχείη — spear; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις), instrumental
ἐλαίῳ: ἔλαιον — olive oil; neut. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with oil’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐντὸς: ἐντός — within, inside; adv., or prep. + gen.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’) · also in ἐξ αὖτις, adverbial: ’again, once more’
ἐοῦσα: εἰμί — be; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic ἐοῦσα (= Attic οὖσα): ’being’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’) · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (left) side’ (ἐπ’ ἀριστερόφιν ’on the left’) · also + gen., ’on’ (ἐπ’ εὐνάων ’on anchor-stones’)
ἐπέδραμον: ἐπιτρέχω — run at, rush upon; aor. 3 pl. (stem δραμ-)
ἐπεσσεύοντο: ἐπισεύομαι — hurry on, rush to; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐπεσεύοντο): ’hastened on’
ἐπύθοντο: πυνθάνομαι — learn, hear, find out; aor. 3 pl. mid. dep., augmented: ’learned’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’)
ἐστιχόωντο: στιχάομαι — march in rows, go in ranks; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐστιχῶντο)
ἐτίθει: τίθημι — put, place; impf. 3 sg.; in tmesis with ἐν (ἐν … ἐτίθει = ἐνετίθει): ’put in’
ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + dat. ’on’ · also + acc., ’to, towards’ · also in ὅσσον ἐφ’ …, ἐπί of unclear attachment: ’(lying) on, at’ · also + dat., ’against’ (Τρωσὶν ἐφ’ ἱπποδάμοισιν ’against the Trojans’) · also + gen., ’by oneself’ (ἐφ’ ὑμείων ’by yourselves, apart’) · also + gen., ’upon’ (ἐφ’ ὑμετέρων ὀχέων ’upon your chariot’) · also + gen., ’over, around’ (ἐφ’ ὁμίλου ’over the crowd’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐφ’ ἱπποπόλων Θρῃκῶν ’toward the horse-herding Thracians’)
ἐφέστασαν: ἐφίστημι — set upon; intrans. stand over, stand about; plpf. 3 pl. with the sense of an imperfect (= Attic ἐφειστήκεσαν): ’stood about’
ἐφεσταότες: ἐφίστημι — stand upon; perf. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic -αότες (= Attic ἐφεστηκότες): ’standing upon’
ἐχέτην: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 dual act., unaugmented (= Attic εἰχέτην): ’the two held out’
ἐῴκει: ἔοικα — be like, resemble; plpf. with impf. force, 3 sg.: ’resembled’
ἑανοῦ: ἑανός — fine, soft; as noun, a fine robe; masc. gen. sg.
ἑζόμενος: ἕζομαι — sit down, sit; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
ἑστήκει: ἵστημι — set, stand; plpf. 3 sg. (perf. ἕστηκα): ’had stood, was standing’
ἑτέρην: ἕτερος — other, second (of two); fem. acc. sg., Ionic η (= Attic ἑτέραν)
ἔγκατα: ἔγκατα — entrails, innards; neut. nom./acc. pl. (only plural)
ἔεργεν: ἔργω (ἐέργω) — keep off, shut out; impf. 3 sg., epic ἔεργεν: ’kept off’
ἔην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen. · also preverb in tmesis (ἔκ … ἐρέω = ἐξερέω ’I shall speak out’)
ἔλασσε: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ-, unaugmented (= ἤλασε): ’drove’
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἔνθ’ ἄρα τε φρένες ἔρχαται ’where the midriff is shut’)
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔραζε: ἔραζε — to the ground, earthward; adv., ἔρα + directional -ζε
ἔρις: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contest; fem. nom. sg. · also Ἔρις — Strife, the goddess; fem. nom. sg.
ἔρυον: ἐρύω — drag, pull, haul; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’were dragging’
ἔχ: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἔχ’ = ἔχε): ’held, kept’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (ἔχ’ = ἔχε): ’keep, hold’
ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’hold, keep’
ἔχον: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶχον): ’held’ · also ’kept, guarded’ · also ’drove’ (ἔχον ἵππους ’drove the horses’) · also pres. part. act. neut. nom. sg., agreeing with a neuter subject: ’holding’ · also ’had, sustained’ (πόνον ἔχον ’sustained toil’)
ἔχοντες: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
ἔχουσα: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕλικας: ἕλιξ — twisted, curved (of cattle’s horns); masc./fem. acc. pl. · also ἕλιξ as a noun — spiral, coil (an ornament); masc. acc. pl.
ἕλκε: ἕλκω — drag, pull; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἷλκε): ’was dragging’ · also ἕλκος — wound, sore; neut. acc. pl. ἕλκεα, elided (ἕλκε’ = ἕλκεα), uncontracted (= Attic ἕλκη): ’wounds’
ἕλκετο: ἕλκω — draw, drag; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic εἵλκετο): ’drew to himself’
ἕποντο: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 3 pl. mid., augmented (ἕποντο = εἵποντο)
ἕρκος: ἕρκος — fence, barrier, bulwark; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), correlative with ἠέ · also ’than’ after a comparative (γλυκίων … ἠὲ νέεσθαι ’sweeter than to go home’) · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question (ἠὲ φυλάσσονται νῆες ’whether the ships are guarded’; ἠὲ κατ’ αἶσαν ἔειπον ’whether I spoke in due measure’)
ἡφαίστοιο: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; by metonymy, fire; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’ · also ’than, except’ after ἄλλος (ἄλλῳ γ’ ἢ Ἀχιλῆϊ ’than Achilles’) · also in τί ἢ ἐμέ, a form of τίη: ’why’ (τί ἢ ἐμὲ ταῦτα διεξερέεσθε ’why do you ask me these things’) · also ἢ = ἦ, ’truly, surely’ (ἐπεὶ ἢ πολὺ φέρτεροί ’for they are truly far better’)
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἣ πληθύς ’the throng’) · also fem. nom. sg. demonstrative, subject of a nominal clause: ’this’
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἥατο: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; impf. 3 pl., epic -ατο (= Attic ἧντο): ’were sitting’
ἥνδανε: ἁνδάνω — please, be pleasing to, + dat.; impf. 3 sg., augmented (η- from the root’s lost digamma)
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἦν)
ἦρχε: ἄρχω — begin, rule, lead; impf. 3 sg., absolute: ’led the way’ · also + gen. of the people or ships led: ’was leading’ (τῶν ἦρχε … νεῶν) · also + gen. of what is begun: ’began, led off’ (μύθων ἦρχε ’led off the talk’) · also + dat. of the troops led: ’led’ (ἦρχε … σφιν ’led them’)
ἧκε: ἵημι — send, let go, let fall; aor. 3 sg. (with πρό in tmesis: ’sent forth’) · also with ἐξ in tmesis: ’sent out’ (ἐξ … ἧκε = ἐξῆκε) · also with ἐν in tmesis: ’sent in, let loose among’ (ἐν … κυδοιμὸν ἧκε ’sent uproar among’)
ἰδὲ: ἰδέ — and; epic conj. (= Attic καί)
ἱέμενοι: ἵεμαι — strain toward, long for, be eager; pres. part. mid./dep. masc. nom. pl., + gen.: ’making for’
ἱκέσθαι: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, arrive at; aor. inf.
ἱμερόεντα: ἱμερόεις — full of longing, arousing longing (ἵμερος ’longing’); neut. acc. pl.
ἱστάμενοι: ἵστημι — mid. stand, take one’s stand; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’standing’
ἴκελον: ἴκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); neut. acc. sg. (epic, = Attic ὅμοιος)
ἴρηξ: ἴρηξ — hawk; masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἱέραξ)
ἴσαν: εἶμι — go, come; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’went’ · also οἶδα — know; plpf. 3 pl., epic ἴσαν (= Attic ᾔδεσαν): ’knew’
ἵκανον: ἱκάνω — come, arrive at; impf. 3 pl. act., epic (Attic ἀφικνέομαι): ’they came to’
ἵκοντο: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (short ι by metre; where the metre makes the ι long, augmented, which the spelling cannot show)
ὀλοὴ: ὀλοός — deadly, destructive; fem. nom. sg.
ὀρθοκραιράων: ὀρθόκραιρα — straight-horned; adj., fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), with βοῶν · also fem. gen. pl., agreeing with νεῶν: ’straight-horned (ships)’
ὀτρύνοντες: ὀτρύνω — urge on, spur on, incite; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
ὁμίλεον: ὁμιλέω — be in company, throng; impf. 3 pl., uncontracted (= Attic ὡμίλουν): ’thronged’
ὁππότε: ὁππότε — when; temporal conj., epic doubled π (= ὁπότε)
ὁπότε: ὁπότε — whenever, when; temporal conj., + opt. in a general clause · also + aor. subj. in a general temporal clause, with no κε: ’whenever’ (ὁπότε … στυφελίξῃ ’whenever it drives’) · also + pres. indic. in a simile: ’as when’ (ὡς δ’ ὁπότε … κάτεισι ’as when … goes down’)
ὁτὲ: ὁτέ (= τοτέ) — at one time, now; adv., correlative ὁτὲ μέν … ἄλλοτε δέ ’at one time … at another’
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὄγμον: ὄγμος — furrow, swath (row of cut grain); masc. acc. sg.
ὄπισθε: ὄπισθε(ν) — behind, at the back; adv.
ὄπισθεν: ὄπισθεν — behind, from behind; adv. · also of time: ’afterwards, hereafter’
ὄχθας: ὄχθη — bank (of a river); fem. acc. pl.
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’) · also prep. + φι-form of cause: ’under, by’ (ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν ’by the might of Peleus’ son’) · also prep. + acc., of time or condition throughout: ’under’ (ὑπὸ μηνιθμόν ’all the while under the wrath’) · also prep. + gen. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Πατρόκλοιο δαμῆναι ’to be subdued by Patroclus’)
ὠκεανοῖο: Ὠκεανός — Ocean, the river encircling the earth; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile · also introducing a wish with the optative alone: ’would that’ (ὡς ἔρις … ἀπόλοιτο ’would that strife perish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤμοισι: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’) · also ὥς before the enclitic τοι, in a clause after πείθεο: ’as’ (ὥς τοι … θείω ’as I set for you’) · also ὥς accented before the enclitic τις (ὥς τίς τε λέων ’like some lion’)
ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥεῖα: ῥεῖα — easily, lightly; adv. (= Attic ῥᾳδίως)
